content: One paper (Goedel-Code-Prover, hierarchical proof search for code verification) accepted at COLM 2026.
One paper (QUARRY, difficulty-aware decomposition for automating Rocq proofs) accepted at OOPSLA 2026.
One paper (about conformal prediction) accepted at KDD 2026.
Our work on automated proof search for seL4 was accepted at OSDI 2026.
One paper (AlgoVeri, a benchmark for verified code generation) accepted at ICML 2026.
My Ph.D. thesis received the CCF Outstanding Doctoral Dissertation Award.
Two papers (about conformal prediction and formal theorem proving) accepted at ICLR 2026.
Two papers (about theorem proving and LLM reasoning) accepted at NeurIPS 2025.
One paper (PyEuclid, a formal plane geometry system) accepted at CAV 2025.
Two papers (about autoformalization and neuro-symbolic data generation) accepted at NeurIPS 2024.
